scripts.db:seed: npm run db:seed:trips && npm run db:seed:pokedex && npm run db:seed:hunts
scripts.install:all: npm install && cd app_angular && npm install && cd ../app_react && npm install
scripts.launch: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:angular" "npm run start:react"
scripts.combine:js: find app_server app_api -type f -name '*.js' -exec sh -c 'for f; do echo "$f :"; cat "$f"; echo ""; done' _ {} + > ../../server_api_code.txt
scripts.combine:ts: find app_react/src -type f \( -name '*.ts' -o -name '*.tsx' \) -exec sh -c 'for f; do echo "$f:"; cat "$f"; echo ""; done' _ {} + > ../../tscode.txt
scripts.combine:all: npm run combine:js && npm run combine:ts && npm run tree
